Presence is powerful

Be in the moment of patient care. We’ll handle the rest.

Readily available. Always adaptable.

Our technology works seamlessly across desktop and mobile devices in both iOS and Android for 100+ specialties. It also adapts to where and how you work — in various care settings as well as with all major EHRs, plus healthtech partners across telehealth, care management, and more.

Suki for Clinicians

Our comprehensive AI assistant helps clinicians be more present by spanning the entire workflow — from pre-charting to documentation to clinical reasoning — all in a first party app.

Built different

No other platform comes close to what Suki can do. Our all-in-one ambient technology powers every workflow for maximum flexibility and interoperability.

Fully AI native

Built with intelligence at its core and designed to innovate quickly, Suki delivers personalized experiences and future-proofed solutions that clinicians can trust.

End-to-end capabilities

We don’t stop at clinical notes. As a true AI assistant, we combine documentation, coding, clinical reasoning, and Q&A in a single solution while continuously adding more features.

Incomparable EHR integration

Our deep, real-time integrations with the four leading EHRs — Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth, and MEDITECH — make Suki the most embedded ambient AI solution on the market.

Exceptional data strength

AI is only as good as the data it’s trained on. Our EHR integrations and industry partnerships mean we have the ability to leverage an extensive dataset to provide the most applicable output.

Truly enterprise grade

Our platform not only boasts a robust security posture, but is also infinitely scalable, SOC2 Type 2 certified, and HIPAA compliant to support the largest organizations in the industry.
